scope: The supplied packet alone was read. Each complete answer was assessed against the question, original answer, source facts, scope limitations, claims, and protected literals. No external source lookup or behavior execution was needed.

hash_verification.method: SHA256 of each decoded JSON answer text, extracted with jq -j and passed directly to shasum -a 256. Leading whitespace and final newlines were retained; no trimming or normalization was applied.

verdict_policy: An answer fails overall if it omits required content, changes an operational qualification or protected literal, makes an unsupported substantive assertion, or includes unrelated text. Semantic claim outcomes and exact-literal outcomes are recorded separately. Repetition does not erase an earlier incorrect or unsupported assertion.
